directions.interpretation: The venues support a shared mechanism of constraint-driven iteration, not one common benchmark or growth rate.
directions.label: Constraints Become Executable
directions.next_comparison: Match design suites, correctness oracle, synthesis budget, model/API cost, retries, and held-out transfer.

venue_roles.dac: Design-automation cases provide broad tool-grounded generation, search, and mapping candidates.
venue_roles.iccad: Fallback cases expose verification, physical-flow, and design-method consequences.
venue_roles.isca: Architecture/compiler cases expose executable dataflow and system constraints.

directions.interpretation: The shared pressure is movement and contention; mechanisms and quality targets remain heterogeneous.
directions.label: Data Movement As Contract
directions.next_comparison: Match workload, recall/accuracy, resident set, capacity, bandwidth, topology, migration cost, and tail latency.

venue_roles.dac: Memory and accelerator cases expose CXL, near-memory, PIM, buffering, and movement-aware execution mechanisms.
venue_roles.iccad: Physical-integration cases connect bandwidth and placement to 3D thermal and package constraints.
venue_roles.isca: Systems and architecture cases expose expert traffic, collectives, KV locality, PIM scheduling, and deployed memory context.

directions.interpretation: The venues converge on explicit operating envelopes, but fault, thermal, and threat models cannot be collapsed into one robustness score.
directions.label: Reliability Security Upstream
directions.next_comparison: Match threat/fault model, coverage, false negatives, recovery cost, useful throughput, and availability impact.

venue_roles.dac: Accelerator and design-flow cases expose fault mitigation, physical integrity, attacks, and protection overhead.
venue_roles.iccad: Security and fallback design cases expose threat-model and validation boundaries, with broader physical-reliability scope.
venue_roles.isca: Architecture and memory cases expose correction, interference, and thermal behavior during execution.

directions.interpretation: The layering suggests physical models are becoming decision inputs, but model transfer and manufacturability remain open.
directions.label: Physical Reality In The Loop
directions.next_comparison: Compare candidate ranking, constraint violations, held-out high-fidelity evaluation, and search cost across geometry/process changes.

venue_roles.dac: Design-automation cases expose fast thermal, package, process, and physical models for search.
venue_roles.iccad: Physical-design fallback cases provide the deepest placement, process, device, and signoff-oriented evidence.
venue_roles.isca: Selected runtime/system cases expose thermal imbalance and physical effects after mapping.

directions.interpretation: This is a methodological bridge across venues, not evidence that the same adaptive loop dominates any venue.
directions.label: Closed Loop Design
directions.next_comparison: Match total wall-clock/evaluation budget, calibration cost, rejected candidates, misranking, and out-of-distribution error.

venue_roles.dac: Search, surrogate, Bayesian, and tool-feedback cases provide the broadest loop inventory.
venue_roles.iccad: Design-space and physical-model cases expose fidelity, calibration, and downstream feasibility boundaries.
venue_roles.isca: The current selected source map has no direct ISCA evidence reference for this direction; compiler/system cases remain adjacent evidence.

directions.interpretation: Evaluation is a cross-venue enabling layer; field direction cannot be inferred until evaluator populations and semantics are matched.
directions.label: Evaluation As Research
directions.next_comparison: Require task population, evaluator/tool version, timeout/error semantics, baseline, budget, and independent rerun status.

venue_roles.dac: Tool-grounded and benchmark cases expose task selection, search budget, and evaluator semantics.
venue_roles.iccad: Verification and physical-design cases expose proof state, simulator fidelity, and implementation boundaries.
venue_roles.isca: Artifact and system cases expose execution, workload, and reproducibility boundaries.

prohibited_inference: rising or declining direction without comparable historical snapshots
